title: Issue Closing Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan · #361 issue closing: the agent closes issues itself, under a guard · house-rules 2.69.0 to 2.70.0

short.lead: This is the build plan for issue closing, issue #361. On the proposal page docs/plans/2026-10-20-issue-closing.html you chose three options. 1A: close an issue only after your QA pass and a merge to main. 2A: clear the 124 open issues through one sweep page, a page that lists issues for you to approve closing in one go. 3A: close an issue as not planned only through a sweep or a list of issues you name. The mechanism is written up in docs/4-systems/issue-closing.md. The work is 4 sub-issues, #362 to #365, each built by one helper agent at a time. Step 2 of the restructure (#340) is paused until this ships, and then continues as house-rules 2.71.0 instead of 2.70.0.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it creates or changes and what it needs.
items: file
Step 1
The closable record (#362)

When you pass QA on a feature, the plugin's hook script saves that feature's issues in a new list called "closable". The list sits in the stage file, the file that records which stage the design loop is in.
The "closable" list is kept when you approve the next design. Today that approval erases the recorded issues (hook.py:5533).
When a pull request merges into main, every saved entry that has a QA pass but no merge recorded yet is marked with that pull request's number.
Nothing from you. Done when verify.py (the script that checks the hooks do what the docs say) passes twice, with one test case for each of the three behaviours above.
lock
Step 2
The close guard (#363)
The guard is the check that runs before any command that closes an issue. It lets a close through only when the issue has both a QA pass and a merge on record, or is on a list you approved.
Any other close is refused, and the refusal names what is missing.
Closes through the GitHub tool this session uses are checked too; today only gh commands are.
An allowed close comments with its evidence, swaps "in progress" for "AjsAgent completed this", and drops "Claude completed this".
Nothing from you. Depends on step 1.
search
Step 3
Sweep approvals and named lists (#364)
Your reply "Sweep approved: issues" records the sweep page's approved closes.
Your message "Close as not planned: #N replaced by #M" (where #N is an issue to close and #M is the issue that replaces it) records a not-planned close for the issues you name, and no others.
The sweep page only ever lists issues the agent opened.
Nothing from you. Depends on step 2.
check
Step 4
Rule text, docs, version and QA (#365)
Rule 6 of rules/detail/issue-workflow.md and the short rule in rules/house-rules.md change to the new rule.
The plugin goes from 2.69.0 to 2.70.0.
A QA page, then a pull request to main once you pass it.
You: answer "QA passed: issue closing" or "QA failed: issue closing". After it ships, the sweep page for the 124 open issues comes to you.

changes: From "always asks you" to "closes itself once the evidence is on record".
Every close asks you, so nothing closes
Closes after your QA pass and a merge, or your approved list
The guard checks the evidence from the local stage file, so it makes no network call on a tool call.
Finished issues close with their evidence in a comment
Your issue list shows only work that is still open
Everything else in the issue workflow
Issues before code, Refs in pull requests, and labels stay as they are.
A pull request still never says Closes, Fixes or Resolves, because GitHub would close the issue at merge, before your QA.
